children: US commercial bank's Q3 net interest income rose 26.3% yr/yr
Q3 diluted EPS climbed to $2.58 from $0.67 a year earlier
Net interest margin expanded to 4.36% from 3.88% a year ago
Company raises quarterly dividend to $0.40 per share, citing confidence in long-term outlook
LOAN AND SECURITIES GROWTH - Co said higher average balances of loans and securities contributed to net interest income increase

HIGHER YIELDS AND LOAN PAYOFFS - Co attributed net interest margin expansion to higher yields on loans and securities, elevated prepayment penalties and deferred fee recognition from increased loan payoffs
IMPROVED DEPOSIT MIX - Co said lower cost of funds was driven by improved deposit mix and lower short-term rates
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the banks peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp is $108.00, about 24.8% above its October 19 closing price of $86.53
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 9 three months ago
